name: Dodge County, WI
findings: Dodge County has 229 nonprofit organizations. 100 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 78 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Dodge County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Dodge County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 115 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Housing organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 housing organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
